name: Horse
identity: Golden-brown spotted horse with cream forelock, stern cream eyes, ochre mane and long ochre tail, a rectangular gold saddle pad with ivory border, four hooves. No rider.
observed_reference_notes: Original assembled source shows cream swept forelock, pale noseband/cheek fitting, gold pad bordered ivory/gray, girth strap, spotted ochre rump, long down-hanging ochre tail, four dark hooves. Tail root must be top center; Up plain rear head.
